versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֑ם הָעֹלִ֣ים עִמִּ֗י בְּמַלְכ֛וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִבָּבֶֽל׃ס

controles.web: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
controles.kjv: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
controles.livre: Estes, pois, são os chefes de suas famílias, com suas genealogias, dos que subiram comigo da Babilônia durante o reinando do rei Artaxerxes:

versos.hebraico: מִבְּנֵ֤י פִֽינְחָס֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔םס מִבְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר דָּנִיֵּ֑אלס מִבְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד חַטּֽוּשׁ׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Fineias, Gérson; dos filhos de Itamar, Daniel; dos filhos de Davi, Hatus;

versos.hebraico: מִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁכַנְיָ֔הס מִבְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖שׁ זְכַרְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ הִתְיַחֵ֥שׂ לִזְכָרִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Secanias e dos filhos de Parós, Zacarias, e com ele por genealogias foram contados cento e cinquenta homens;

versos.hebraico: מִבְּנֵי֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְיְהֽוֹעֵינַ֖י בֶּן־זְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Pahath–moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Paate-Moabe, Elioenai, filho de Zeraías, e com ele duzentos homens;

versos.hebraico: מִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־יַחֲזִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Secanias, o filho de Jaaziel, e com ele trezentos homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין עֶ֖בֶד בֶּן־יוֹנָתָ֑ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
controles.kjv: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Adim, Ebede, filho de Jônatas, e com ele cinquenta homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה בֶּן־עֲתַלְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Elão, Jesaías, filho de Atalias, e com ele setenta homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה זְבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מִֽיכָאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֖וֹ שְׁמֹנִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Sefatias, Zebadias, filho de Micael, e com ele oitenta homens;

versos.hebraico: מִבְּנֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן־יְחִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Joabe, Obadias, filho de Jeiel, e com ele duzentos e dezoito homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁלוֹמִ֖ית בֶּן־יוֹסִפְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Selomite, o filho de Josifias, e com ele cento e sessenta homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בֵבַ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־בֵּבָ֑י וְעִמּ֕וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Bebai, Zacarias, filho de Bebai, e com ele vinte e oito homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד יוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן־הַקָּטָ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Azgade, Joanã, filho de Catã, e com ele cento e dez homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִיקָם֮ אַחֲרֹנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔ם אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט יְעִיאֵ֣ל וּֽשְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last; and these are their names: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.
controles.kjv: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Adonicão, os últimos, cujos nomes são: Elifelete, Jeiel, e Semaías, e com eles sessenta homens;

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י בִגְוַ֖י עוּתַ֣י וזבוד וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃פ

controles.web: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.
controles.kjv: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Bigvai, Utai e Zabude, e com eles setenta homens.

versos.hebraico: וָֽאֶקְבְּצֵ֗ם אֶל־הַנָּהָר֙ הַבָּ֣א אֶֽל־אַהֲוָ֔א וַנַּחֲנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֣ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וָאָבִ֤ינָה בָעָם֙ וּבַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּמִבְּנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י לֹא־מָצָ֥אתִי שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
controles.kjv: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
controles.livre: E ajuntei-os junto ao rio que vai a Aava, e acampamos ali três dias; então procurem entre o povo e entre os sacerdotes, não achei ali nenhum dos filhos de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֡ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֡זֶר לַאֲרִיאֵ֡ל לִֽ֠שְׁמַעְיָה וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּלְיָרִ֜יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֧ן וּלְנָתָ֛ן וְלִזְכַרְיָ֥ה וְלִמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים וּלְיוֹיָרִ֥יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֖ן מְבִינִֽים׃

controles.web: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, who were teachers.
controles.kjv: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
controles.livre: Por isso enviei a Eliezer, Ariel, Semaías, Elnatã, Jaribe, Elnatã, Natã, Zacarias, e a Mesulão, os chefes; como também a Joiaribe e a Elnatã, os sábios.

versos.hebraico: ואוצאה אוֹתָם֙ עַל־אִדּ֣וֹ הָרֹ֔אשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָ֖א הַמָּק֑וֹם וָאָשִׂימָה֩ בְּפִיהֶ֨ם דְּבָרִ֜ים לְ֠דַבֵּר אֶל־אִדּ֨וֹ אָחִ֤יו הנתונים בְּכָסִפְיָ֣א הַמָּק֔וֹם לְהָֽבִיא־לָ֥נוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo, and his brothers the Nethinim, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.
controles.kjv: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
controles.livre: E os enviei a Ido, chefe no lugar de Casifia; e lhes instruí  as palavras que deviam dizer a Ido, e a seus irmãos, os servos do templo no lugar de Casifia, para que nos trouxessem trabalhadores para a casa de nosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבִ֨יאּוּ לָ֜נוּ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ הַטּוֹבָ֤ה עָלֵ֨ינוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ שֶׂ֔כֶל מִבְּנֵ֣י מַחְלִ֔י בֶּן־לֵוִ֖י בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
controles.kjv: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
controles.livre: E nos trouxeram, segundo a boa mão de nosso Deus sobre nós, um homem entendido dos filhos de Mali, filho de Levi, filho de Israel; cujo nome era Serebias com seus filhos e seus irmãos, dezoito;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְאִתּ֥וֹ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה מִבְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֶחָ֥יו וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
controles.kjv: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
controles.livre: E a Hasabias, e com ele a Jesaías dos filhos de Merari, seus irmãos e a seus filhos, vinte;

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַנְּתִינִ֗ים שֶׁנָּתַ֨ן דָּוִ֤יד וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נְתִינִ֖ים מָאתַ֣יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְּב֥וּ בְשֵׁמֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and of the Nethinim, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim: all of them were mentioned by name.
controles.kjv: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
controles.livre: E dos servos do templo, a quem Davi e os príncipes puseram para o trabalho dos Levitas, duzentos e vinte servos do templo; todos eles foram indicados por nome.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקְרָ֨א שָׁ֥ם צוֹם֙ עַל־הַנָּהָ֣ר אַהֲוָ֔א לְהִתְעַנּ֖וֹת לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ וּלְטַפֵּ֖נוּ וּלְכָל־רְכוּשֵֽׁנוּ׃

controles.web: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek of him a straight way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
controles.kjv: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
controles.livre: Então proclamei ali um jejum junto ao rio de Aava, para nos humilharmos diante de nosso Deus, para lhe pedirmos um caminho seguro para nós, nossos filhos, e todos os nossos bens.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י בֹ֗שְׁתִּי לִשְׁא֤וֹל מִן־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חַ֣יִל וּפָרָשִׁ֔ים לְעָזְרֵ֥נוּ מֵאוֹיֵ֖ב בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ כִּֽי־אָמַ֨רְנוּ לַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֗ר יַד־אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ עַל־כָּל־מְבַקְשָׁיו֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה וְעֻזּ֣וֹ וְאַפּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל־עֹזְבָֽיו׃

controles.web: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”
controles.kjv: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
controles.livre: Pois tive vergonha de pedir ao rei tropas e cavaleiros para nos defenderem do inimigo no caminho; porque tínhamos falado ao rei, dizendo: A mão de nosso Deus está para o bem sobre todos os que o buscam; mas sua força e ira está sobre todos os que o abandonam.

versos.hebraico: וַנָּצ֛וּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁ֥ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַל־זֹ֑את וַיֵּעָתֵ֖ר לָֽנוּ׃

controles.web: So we fasted and begged our God for this: and he was entreated of us.
controles.kjv: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
controles.livre: Assim jejuamos, e pedimos isto a nosso Deus; e ele atendeu a nossas orações.

versos.hebraico: וָאַבְדִּ֛ילָה מִשָּׂרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר לְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְעִמָּהֶ֥ם מֵאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃

controles.web: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
controles.kjv: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
controles.livre: Então separei doze dos chefes dos sacerdotes, a Serebias e Hasabias, e com eles dez de seus irmãos;

versos.hebraico: ואשקולה לָהֶ֔ם אֶת־הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִ֑ים תְּרוּמַ֣ת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַהֵרִ֨ימוּ֙ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְיֹעֲצָ֣יו וְשָׂרָ֔יו וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּמְצָאִֽים׃

controles.web: and weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, and his counselors, and his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered:
controles.kjv: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
controles.livre: E pesei-lhes a prata, o ouro, e os utensílios, que eram a oferta para a casa de nosso Deus que o rei, seus conselheiros, seus príncipes, e todo os israelitas que se acharam, haviam oferecido.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁקֲלָ֨ה עַל־יָדָ֜ם כֶּ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ־מֵא֣וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים וּכְלֵי־כֶ֥סֶף מֵאָ֖ה לְכִכָּרִ֑ים זָהָ֖ב מֵאָ֥ה כִכָּֽר׃

controles.web: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels one hundred talents; of gold one hundred talents;
controles.kjv: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
controles.livre: Assim pesei nas mãos deles seiscentos e cinquenta talentos de prata, e cem talentos de utensílios de prata, e cem talentos de ouro;

versos.hebraico: וּכְפֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּכְלֵ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת מֻצְהָ֤ב טוֹבָה֙ שְׁנַ֔יִם חֲמוּדֹ֖ת כַּזָּהָֽב׃

controles.web: and twenty bowls of gold, of one thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright brass, precious as gold.
controles.kjv: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
controles.livre: E vinte bacias de ouro, de mil dracmas; e dois vasos bronze reluzente, tão preciosos como o ouro.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהַכֵּלִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְהַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ נְדָבָ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.
controles.kjv: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the Lord; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the Lord God of your fathers.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Vós sois consagrados ao SENHOR, e estes utensílios são santos; como também a prata e o ouro, que são oferta voluntária ao SENHOR, Deus de vossos pais.

versos.hebraico: שִׁקְד֣וּ וְשִׁמְר֗וּ עַֽד־תִּשְׁקְל֡וּ לִפְנֵי֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם וְשָׂרֵֽי־הָאָב֥וֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הַלִּשְׁכ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Watch, and keep them, until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”
controles.kjv: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: Vigiai, e guardai estas coisas , até que as peseis diante dos líderes dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e dos chefes das famílias de Israel em Jerusalém, nas câmaras da casa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְקִבְּלוּ֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִשְׁקַ֛ל הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֖ב וְהַכֵּלִ֑ים לְהָבִ֥יא לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃פ

controles.web: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.
controles.kjv: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
controles.livre: Então os sacerdotes e os levitas receberam o peso da prata e do ouro e dos utensílios, para o trazerem a Jerusalém, à casa de nosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַֽנִּסְעָ֞ה מִנְּהַ֣ר אַֽהֲוָ֗א בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן לָלֶ֖כֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיַד־אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ הָיְתָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וַיַּ֨צִּילֵ֔נוּ מִכַּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֛ב וְאוֹרֵ֖ב עַל־הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃

controles.web: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandit by the way.
controles.kjv: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
controles.livre: Assim nos partimos do rio de Aava, ao dia doze do mês primeiro, para irmos a Jerusalém; e a mão do nosso Deus estava sobre nós, e nos livrou de mão de inimigos e dos assaltantes no caminho.

versos.hebraico: וַנָּב֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַנֵּ֥שֶׁב שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.
controles.kjv: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
controles.livre: E chegamos a Jerusalém, e repousamos ali três dias.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֡י נִשְׁקַ֣ל הַכֶּסֶף֩ וְהַזָּהָ֨ב וְהַכֵּלִ֜ים בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַ֠ל יַד־מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן־פִּֽינְחָ֑ס וְעִמָּהֶ֞ם יוֹזָבָ֧ד בֶּן־יֵשׁ֛וּעַ וְנֽוֹעַדְיָ֥ה בֶן־בִּנּ֖וּי הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levite;
controles.kjv: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
controles.livre: Ao quarto dia foram pesados a prata, o ouro, e os utensílios, na casa de nosso Deus, por meio de Meremote, filho do sacerdote Urias, e com ele Eleazar filho de Fineias; e com eles os levitas Jozabade filho de Jesuá, e Noadias filho de Binui.

versos.hebraico: בְּמִסְפָּ֥ר בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל לַכֹּ֑ל וַיִּכָּתֵ֥ב כָּֽל־הַמִּשְׁקָ֖ל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃פ

controles.web: the whole by number and by weight: and all the weight was written at that time.
controles.kjv: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
controles.livre: Tudo foi conferido em número e em peso; e ao mesmo tempo o peso foi registrado.

versos.hebraico: הַ֠בָּאִים מֵֽהַשְּׁבִ֨י בְנֵֽי־הַגּוֹלָ֜ה הִקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹל֣וֹת׀ לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּרִ֨ים שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵילִ֣ים׀ תִּשְׁעִ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֗ה כְּבָשִׂים֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֔ה צְפִירֵ֥י חַטָּ֖את שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הַכֹּ֖ל עוֹלָ֥ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E os transportados, os que vieram do cativeiro,  deram como oferta de queima ao Deus de Israel doze novilhos por todos os israelitas, noventa e seis carneiros, setenta e sete cordeiros, e doze bodes como sacrifício pelo pecado; tudo isto como oferta de queima ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּתְּנ֣וּ׀ אֶת־דָּתֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּפַחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר וְנִשְּׂא֥וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם וְאֶת־בֵּֽית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס

controles.web: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s satraps, and to the governors beyond the River: and they furthered the people and God’s house.
controles.kjv: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
controles.livre: Então deram as ordens do rei aos comissários  do rei, e aos governadores dalém do rio, os quais ajudaram ao povo e à casa de Deus.
